description: A rough granite boulder for a low-poly fantasy RPG — irregular surface, flat base, chunky silhouette

Australian boab tree: fat squat barrel trunk (max diameter ≈ trunk height, widest near mid-trunk), crown branches spreading nearly horizontally at ~60° from vertical connecting trunk to canopy, wide flat leaf canopy at branch tips, pale grey-brown bark with vertex color variation, green leaf clusters at branch endpoints — branches must visually connect the trunk crown to the canopy (no floating gap)

a hand of 5 ripe yellow bananas joined at a green-brown stem at the top; bananas are arrayed SIDE-BY-SIDE along the X axis (NOT radially) — all curve in the same Y-Z direction: forward then downward, like fingers on a hand. Each banana is a custom capped tube (buildCappedTube) with Frenet frames; bright yellow vertex colors; small dark brown icosphere tips; green-brown cylindrical stem. Critical: winding for side quads is push(a,d,c, a,b,d) — never push(a,c,d, a,d,b). Never use TubeGeometry.
A bunch of 12 colorful party balloons — red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, magenta, white — clustered tightly together with strings hanging below, low-poly game asset
